# Tied headscarf yellow

Internal ID: HelmetHat6 | Type: Head | Source: Hildir | Buy: 250, Coins | Armor: 1 | Base Item Stamina Usage: -15%

# Introduction

Tied headscarf yellow is an armor piece which can be purchased from Hildir for 250 Coins. This item will be in the merchant's assortment only after returning Hildir's silver chest.

## Notes

• Wearing this armor decreases stamina usage while using the Hammer, the Hoe, the Cultivator, and the Serving tray by 15%.

Categorias: Armor, Head
